{{Top|leg}}
'''Med-aids''' were smaller versions of [[medkit]]s. They provided rudimentary first aid equipment to deal with minor injuries such as burns, cuts, or contusions. More expensive med-aids could contain more specialist equipment such as anti-venom supplements and [[Painkiller/Legends|pain killers]]. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] era, [[Jassim Design]] produced the [[QuickMed]] med-aid.
